rows.definition:
SELECT id,
    vendor,
    index_url,
    last_success_at
   FROM update_sources
  WHERE enabled;

SELECT c.id,
    s.vendor,
    c.title,
    c.draft_summary AS summary,
    c.canonical_url AS source_url,
    c.published_date AS source_published_date,
    c.source_checked_at,
    c.published_at,
    c.evidence_level
   FROM update_candidates c
     JOIN update_sources s ON s.id = c.source_id
  WHERE c.state = 'published'::text;
